SEEge Teacher dashboard

Attendance for Google Meet that students opt in to.

SEEge logs when students join, leave and switch tabs. It never reads chat, audio or video.

Sample data
What SEEge records and why

What it records

  • Your real name and when you consented
  • When you join and leave a monitored Meet
  • How long you are away from the Meet tab
  • Counts of chat sends, reactions and microphone openings, when Meet exposes them

What it never records

  • Chat text, audio, video or screenshots
  • Anything you do on other websites
  • Any class you are not rostered in

Who can see it

  • Your teacher sees your name and session activity, and can send it in a report to their own Gmail
  • Sign-in sends your account email to Firebase Authentication
  • Tracking starts only after you consent, and only for an active class you are rostered in

How long it is kept

  • Session data is scheduled for deletion after 90 days. It can be delayed if your teacher's extension is not running
  • Request deletion from this popup, or contact the maintainer through the SEEge GitHub repository
